gaps.title: Real‑time cold‑chain monitoring
gaps.detail: Preferred Freezer operates millions of cubic feet of refrigerated space but the research mentions no temperature sensor network, risking compliance gaps for pharma and food customers.
gaps.based_on: Preferred Freezer Services was founded in 1989 with a 1.3‑million‑cubic‑foot refrigerated facility in Perth Amboy, New Jersey.

gaps.title: Unified inventory visibility across 39 sites
gaps.detail: With 39 warehouses in 9 U.S. regions and international sites, the company likely relies on disparate WMS (Accellos) and manual counts, limiting real‑time inventory accuracy.
gaps.based_on: The firm operates modern, temperature‑controlled warehouses across the United States, with 39 sites in 9 regions and international locations in China and Vietnam, totaling more than 338 million cubic feet of space.

gaps.title: Asset & equipment tracking
gaps.detail: The 170,000‑sq‑ft Elizabeth facility runs 30 staff with high‑throughput pallets; adding IoT trackers to lift trucks and AS/RS cranes would reduce loss and improve utilization.
gaps.based_on: A 170,000‑sq‑ft facility in Elizabeth, NJ includes 140,000 sq ft of automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS) and processes about 1,020 pallets per day with a staff of 30.

pitch.angle:
- Highlight their massive 338 M cu ft footprint – we can give you real‑time temperature and inventory data across every site.
- Their early adoption of white‑roof energy tech shows they value innovation; our IoT platform adds another efficiency layer.
- Integrate with existing Accellos WMS and LTW AS/RS to turn manual counts into automated, sensor‑driven accuracy.
- Provide instant deviation alerts and compliance reports to meet pharma, food and vaccine regulations worldwide.
pitch.opener: I saw Preferred Freezer’s 338 million cu ft of cold storage across 39 sites and thought our ThinxFresh platform could deliver real‑time temperature compliance and unified inventory visibility for every location.
